scanNote:
2-MODUL O'Z-O'ZINI BAHOLASH, IKKINChI BET (61-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda 'Module Self-Assessment 2 (Units 5 - 8)'.

CHAP USTUN:
• 5-mashqning davomi (11-15): 11 She hasn't washed the car just/yet. 12 He hasn't smoked since/for years. 13 She washed the dishes after/until her guests had left. 14 I've yet/just finished packing. 15 They didn't move house until/by the time they had had their first baby. (15 marks)
6) 'Fill in the gaps with WILL or AM GOING TO.' Besh dialog. (5 marks)
7) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense.' Besh gap: 1 If I ...... (see) Tom, I'll tell him to call you. 2 What ...... (you/do) if you win the competition? 3 If he ...... (fail) the test, he'll be in trouble. 4 She ...... (help) us if she has enough time. 5 When she ...... (come) back, she'll tell us all the details. (5 marks)
• To'q sariq 'Communication'.
8) 'Complete the dialogues with phrases from the list.' a) Qiya: would you, could I, I'm afraid. A: Good morning. 1) ...... see Mr Harris, please? B: 2) ...... not. He's in a meeting. 3) ...... like to make an appointment? A: Yes, please. b) Qiya: do you, how much, can I. A: 1) ...... help you? B: Yes. Can I have a club sandwich, please? A: Certainly. 2) ...... want anything to drink? B: A Diet Coke, please. A: Anything else? B: No thanks. 3) ...... is that? A: That's £3.20. (6 marks)

O'NG USTUN:
• To'q sariq 'Reading'.
9) 'Read the letter and answer the questions.' SURAT: Gavayi plyaji - palmalar, oq qum, ko'k dengiz. XAT (sarg'ish qog'oz, qo'l yozuvi shriftida, o'ngda 'Para 1', 'Para 2', 'Para 3' belgilari):
   'Dear Ann, Thanks a lot for your letter. You're going to have a great summer, it seems. Your plans sound fantastic. [Para 1]
   I've got a lot of plans for the summer, too. Firstly, I'm going to relax for a while because I'm very tired, then I'm going to have some fun! I'm going on holiday with my friend in June. We're going to spend two weeks in exotic Hawaii! When we come back, I'm going to join my local drama group because, as you know, I want to become an actress one day. I'll let you know when the first performance is, so you can come and watch. At the end of the summer, I'm going to visit my sister in LA. She's getting married on 29th August. Isn't that fantastic? [Para 2]
   Well, that's all for now. I'll send you a postcard from Hawaii. Have a great summer! [Para 3]
   Best wishes, Nicola'
   Savollar: 1 Who is the letter from? 2 Who is the letter to? 3 How does the letter begin? 4 How does the letter end? 5 What are Nicola's plans for the summer? 6 Match the headings to the paragraphs. Plans ......, Greeting ......, Conclusion ...... (12 marks)
• Katta to'q sariq 'Writing'.
10) 'Write a letter to your friend about your summer plans (100 - 150 words). Use the letter in Ex. 9 as a model.' (22 marks)
'TOTAL: 100 marks'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '61'.

exercises.explanationUz:
5-MAShQ DAVOMI - VAQT SO'ZLARI.

  11 hasn't washed ... YET (inkor,
     oxirida)
  12 hasn't smoked FOR years
     (davomiylik)
  13 AFTER her guests had left
     (past perfect bilan)
  14 I've JUST finished (tasdiq)
  15 didn't move UNTIL they had had
     (... gacha)


⚠ 15-BAND - 'HAD HAD':

  'they HAD HAD their first baby' -
  'to have a baby' ning past perfect
  shakli.


⚠ 'TO PACK':

  = chamadon yig'moq.
  ⚠ 'finished packING'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with will or am going to. (5 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'sh joylarni will yoki am going to bilan to'ldiring. (5 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
5-UNIT QOIDASI (36-bet).

  ShU ONDAGI QAROR / TAKLIF → will
  OLDINDAN REJA → am going to


JAVOBLAR:

  1 I WILL bring you some orange
    juice. (shu zahoti taklif)
  2 I AM GOING TO play tennis with
    Jack. (oldindan reja)
  3 I WILL buy some later. (shu
    zahoti qaror - 'I forgot')
  4 I AM GOING TO work at a café.
    ('plans' - reja)
  5 I AM GOING TO leave next Monday.
    ('decided' - qaror qilingan)

items.textEn: 1 A: I'm thirsty.  B: I ___ bring you some orange juice.
2 A: Would you like to come with us?  B: Sorry, I can't. I ___ play tennis with Jack.
3 A: Did you buy any milk?  B: Sorry, I forgot. I ___ buy some later.
4 A: What are your plans for the summer?  B: I ___ work at a café.
5 A: Have you decided when to go on holiday?  B: Yes, I ___ leave next Monday.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense. (5 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying. (5 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
1-TUR ShART GAPLARI VA VAQT
SO'ZLARI (38, 47-betlar).

  if/when + PRESENT SIMPLE,
  will + fe'l


JAVOBLAR:

  1 If I SEE Tom, I'll tell him.
  2 What WILL YOU DO if you win?
    (asosiy gap → will)
  3 If he FAILS the test, he'll be
    in trouble.
  4 She WILL HELP us if she has
    enough time. (asosiy gap → will)
  5 When she COMES back, she'll tell
    us.


⚠ 2 va 4-BANDLAR:

  'if' bo'lagi EMAS, ASOSIY gap →
  'will'.
  ⚠ 'What will you do IF you WIN' -
  'win' present simple, 'will do'
  asosiy.


⚠ 'TO FAIL':

  = yiqilmoq (imtihonda).
  ⚠ 'fails' - 3-shaxs '-s'.

items.textEn: 1 If I ___ (see) Tom, I'll tell him to call you.
2 What ___ (you/do) if you win the competition?
3 If he ___ (fail) the test, he'll be in trouble.
4 She ___ (help) us if she has enough time.
items.whyUz:
⚠ ASOSIY gap → 'will help'.
⚠ 'if she HAS' - present simple.

items.textEn: 5 When she ___ (come) back, she'll tell us all the details.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the dialogues with phrases from the list. (6 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Dialoglarni ro'yxatdagi iboralar bilan to'ldiring. (6 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI DIALOG.


a) NAVBAT OLISh (38-bet):
  A: Good morning. COULD I see Mr
     Harris, please?
  B: I'M AFRAID not. He's in a
     meeting. WOULD YOU like to make
     an appointment?
  A: Yes, please.


b) TEZ OVQAT RESTORANI (43-bet):
  A: CAN I help you?
  B: Yes. Can I have a club sandwich,
     please?
  A: Certainly. DO YOU want anything
     to drink?
  B: A Diet Coke, please.
  A: Anything else?
  B: No thanks. HOW MUCH is that?
  A: That's £3.20.


⚠ "I'M AFRAID NOT":

  = afsuski yo'q.
  ⚠ "I'm afraid so" = afsuski ha.


⚠ '£3.20':

  = 'three pounds twenty'.


⚠ 'IN A MEETING':

  = yig'ilishda.

exercises.explanationUz:
NORASMIY XAT - YoZGI REJALAR.


⚠ 5-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI XATDA:

  'be going to' - REJALAR:
    "I'm going to relax", "I'm going
     to join", "I'm going to visit"
  present continuous - KELIShILGAN:
    "I'm going on holiday in June"
    "She's getting married on 29th
     August"
  'will' - VA'DA/TAXMIN:
    "I'll let you know", "I'll send
     you a postcard"


⚠ NORASMIY XAT BELGILARI:

  'Dear Ann,' (ism bilan)
  qisqartmalar ("I'm", "I've")
  'Well, that's all for now.'
  'Best wishes,'

points.en: [Para 1] Dear Ann, Thanks a lot for your letter. You're going to have a great summer, it seems. Your plans sound fantastic.
points.uz: [1-xatboshi] Aziz Ann, xating uchun katta rahmat. Ko'rinishidan, yozing zo'r o'tadi. Rejalaring ajoyib eshitiladi.

points.en: [Para 2] I've got a lot of plans for the summer, too. Firstly, I'm going to relax for a while because I'm very tired, then I'm going to have some fun! I'm going on holiday with my friend in June. We're going to spend two weeks in exotic Hawaii!
points.uz: [2-xatboshi] Menda ham yozga ko'p rejalar bor. Birinchidan, biroz dam olaman, chunki juda charchaganman, keyin zavqlanaman! Iyunda do'stim bilan ta'tilga ketyapman. Ekzotik Gavayida ikki hafta o'tkazamiz!
points.noteUz:
⚠ "I'm going to relax" - reja.
⚠ "I'm going on holiday in June" - present
continuous: kelishilgan.
⚠ 'to have fun' = zavqlanmoq.

points.en: When we come back, I'm going to join my local drama group because, as you know, I want to become an actress one day. I'll let you know when the first performance is, so you can come and watch.
points.uz: Qaytganimizda mahalliy drama to'garagiga qo'shilaman, chunki bilasan, bir kun aktrisa bo'lishni xohlayman. Birinchi spektakl qachonligini senga aytaman, kelib tomosha qilasan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'When we COME back' - present simple.
⚠ "I'll let you know" = senga aytaman (va'da).
⚠ 'a performance' = spektakl, chiqish.

points.en: At the end of the summer, I'm going to visit my sister in LA. She's getting married on 29th August. Isn't that fantastic?
points.uz: Yoz oxirida Los-Anjelesdagi opamnikiga boraman. U 29-avgustda turmushga chiqyapti. Ajoyib-a?
points.noteUz:
⚠ "She's getting married ON 29th August" -
aniq sana → present continuous.
⚠ 'LA' = Los Angeles.
⚠ "Isn't that fantastic?" - hayajon.

points.en: [Para 3] Well, that's all for now. I'll send you a postcard from Hawaii. Have a great summer! Best wishes, Nicola
points.uz: [3-xatboshi] Xo'sh, hozircha shu. Gavayidan otkritka yuboraman. Yozing zo'r o'tsin! Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan, Nicola
points.noteUz:
⚠ "that's all for now" - norasmiy xat tugashi.
⚠ "I'll send" - va'da.
⚠ 'Best wishes' - norasmiy yakun.

items.en: 6 Match the headings to the paragraphs: Plans, Greeting, Conclusion.
items.uz: 6 Sarlavhalarni xatboshilarga moslang: Rejalar, Salomlashish, Xulosa.
items.answerEn: Greeting - Para 1; Plans - Para 2; Conclusion - Para 3.

REJA (Nicola xati bo'yicha):

  Para 1: Greeting - rahmat, do'st
     rejalari haqida
  Para 2: Plans - o'z rejalaring
     (be going to / present
      continuous / will)
  Para 3: Conclusion - xayrlashish

structure.exampleEn: Dear Ann, Thanks a lot for your letter. It was great to hear from you. Your summer plans sound really exciting!

I've got a lot of plans for the summer, too. Firstly, I'm going to stay at home and rest for a week. Then I'm going to the mountains with my family in July. We're going to spend ten days there. When we come back, I'm going to take a computer course because I want to learn programming. At the end of August, I'm visiting my grandparents in the village. I'll help them in the garden.

structure.hintUz: that's all for now, Best wishes
structure.exampleEn: Well, that's all for now. I'll send you some photos from the mountains. Have a great summer! Best wishes, Aziz

modelAnswers: Dear Ann, Thanks a lot for your letter. It was great to hear from you. Your summer plans sound really exciting!

I've got a lot of plans for the summer, too. Firstly, I'm going to stay at home and rest for a week. Then I'm going to the mountains with my family in July. We're going to spend ten days there. When we come back, I'm going to take a computer course because I want to learn programming. At the end of August, I'm visiting my grandparents in the village. I'll help them in the garden.
Well, that's all for now. I'll send you some photos from the mountains. Have a great summer! Best wishes, Aziz
modelAnswersUz: Aziz Ann, xating uchun katta rahmat. Sendan xabar olganim juda yaxshi bo'ldi. Yozgi rejalaring juda qiziqarli eshitiladi!

Menda ham yozga ko'p rejalar bor. Birinchidan, bir hafta uyda dam olaman. Keyin iyulda oilam bilan toqqa boraman. U yerda o'n kun o'tkazamiz. Qaytganimizda kompyuter kursiga boraman, chunki dasturlashni o'rganmoqchiman. Avgust oxirida qishloqdagi buvi-bobomnikiga boraman. Ularga bog'da yordam beraman.
Xo'sh, hozircha shu. Senga tog'dan suratlar yuboraman. Yozing zo'r o'tsin! Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan, Aziz
